description: Detect and execute erasure coding for suitable volumes

admin_config_form.title: Erasure Coding Admin Config
admin_config_form.description: Admin-side controls for erasure coding detection scope.

sections.title: Scope
sections.description: Optional filters applied before erasure coding detection.

fields.name: collection_filter
fields.label: Collection Filter
fields.description: Only erasure code volumes in matching collections. Comma-separated list of names, wildcards, or regex patterns.

sections.title: Detection Thresholds
sections.description: Controls for when erasure coding jobs should be proposed.

fields.name: quiet_for_seconds
fields.label: Quiet Period (s)
fields.description: Volume must remain unmodified for at least this duration.

fields.name: fullness_ratio
fields.label: Fullness Ratio
fields.description: Minimum volume fullness ratio to trigger erasure coding.

fields.name: min_size_mb
fields.label: Minimum Volume Size (MB)
fields.description: Only volumes larger than this size are considered.

sections.title: Shard Placement
sections.description: Where EC shards go: disk tags, replica-placement caps, Place ranking.

fields.name: preferred_tags
fields.label: Preferred Tags
fields.description: Comma-separated disk tags to prioritize for EC shard placement, ordered by preference.

fields.name: replica_placement
fields.label: Replica Placement
fields.description: EC shard placement (e.g. 020): 2nd/3rd digits cap shards per rack/node (best-effort during encode, enforced by rebalancing); the data-center digit is ignored. Empty uses the master default.

fields.name: free_slots_deadband
fields.label: Free Volume Deadband (M)
fields.description: Nodes whose free volume slots differ by at most M are a tie; then fewer live shards wins. Applied as M × data shards (10+4 → ×10). 0 = always pick more free slots.

fields.name: strict_placement
fields.label: Strict Placement
fields.description: Fail EC planning when the placement constraints cannot be met instead of relaxing them.

sections.title: Shard distribution
sections.description: How many EC shard copies are in flight. The checkbox is presentation only; the saved value is max_shard_transfers.

fields.name: max_shard_transfers
fields.label: Parallel shard distribution
fields.description: Unchecked sends shards sequentially. Checked with an empty max uses one in-flight copy per destination disk. A number is a global cap, still one copy per disk.
